annotations.title: Buscar criadores no Instagram e TikTok

description: Finds small Instagram and TikTok content creators who post about a topic and saves them in a new people sheet (Rede, @, Perfil, Seguidores, Engajamento, Último post, Bio, E-mail, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Post de exemplo). Filters: followers range (1,000 to 50,000 by default), average engagement of the last 12 posts, a post in the last 30 days, Portuguese, a person rather than a brand. The contact is looked up in this order, stopping at the first found: a business account's public e-mail or phone, the bio, the page of the link in the bio, then LinkedIn by the same name and area; a phone counts only when it has WhatsApp. withContact false skips the lookup and keeps every creator that passes. Charged only for creators delivered: 2 credits each and 3 more for a contact found. Above the share of the balance a search spends without asking, the first call returns a quote (status quote) and runs nothing; the call with confirmed true runs. Returns the creators, the contacts by kind, the funnel (funnelText: posts found, kept, why the rest left), creditsCharged and the sheet; partial true when the time ran out first.

confirmed.description: true only after the user agreed to a quote this search returned (status quote).

limit.description: How many creators to deliver (default 10, up to 60), split between the networks.

minEngagement.description: Least average (likes + comments) / followers over the last 12 posts, as a fraction: 0.02 is 2% (default 0.01). 0 turns it off.

topic.description: What the creators post about, as they would write it or as a hashtag: "prospecção", "sdr", "vendasb2b". One topic per call.

withContact.description: true (default): look up an e-mail, a WhatsApp or a LinkedIn and deliver only creators with one. false: no lookup, every creator that passes the filters, with the profile only (for a manual DM).
